text: Openbank is a division of Santander Bank, N.A., which is a wholly owned, indirect subsidiary of the listed Spanish banking group Banco Santander, S.A.
short: Openbank is a Santander Bank division, wholly owned indirectly by Banco Santander, S.A.

source.name: Openbank by Santander: Terms of use
source.quote: Openbank is a division of Santander Bank, N.A., Member FDIC, and a wholly owned, indirect subsidiary of Banco Santander, S.A.
